scope.known_issue: The candidate and attempt assert a 45C maximum, while the only accepted source note records 700×40C fitted and does not support that maximum.

allowed_work: Read the exact target, attempt, and two named SAVA SF6 sources. One Luna evidence-only worker may open the current exact-model manufacturer product page once to check whether it explicitly states maximum tire size. If the source states only a fitted 40C tire, correct the unsupported 45C maximum to a dated fitted-tire observation with maximum unknown and preserve the gap. If a maximum is explicitly stated for the exact frame, record it with its nominal-size caveat. Add only a dated source record if the current page supplies new evidence. stop_conditions: Do not infer maximum clearance from fitted tire width or from a different Gelaro build.
Stop after one current manufacturer page open; do not retry blocked, unavailable, or challenge routes.
Preserve the unresolved 10-speed versus 11-speed candidate-build ambiguity.
done_criteria: The exact-model source either supports a maximum or the unsupported 45C assertion is removed in favor of a clearly labeled fitted-tire observation.
The candidate retains a maximum-unknown state unless explicit source evidence proves a maximum.
Fresh data:gaps and research:queue quantify the post-change state.

Run data validation, research checks, coverage acceptance/check, the full `npm run check` gate once for this data-changing batch, and `git diff --check`. No image report because no image record is in scope.
